keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Millburn Township (Short Hills), homeowners pay an average of $23,675.96 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 9.47% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 88.5%, assessed values average ~88.5% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 63.8% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 20.4%, and Essex County claims 15.8%.
